data.name: Tal'darim

abilities.name: Chain of Ascension
abilities.text: Calculate the total lost Supply of all Friendly Units. While this total is: 4 or more: All your Units' first used weapons gain PRECISION (1). 6 or more: All your Units' first used weapons gain CRITICAL HIT (1).

abilities.name: Proxy Pylon
abilities.text: If there is no Friendly Tal'darim Pylon on the battlefield, set a Friendly Tal'darim Pylon Unit anywhere on the GROUND LEVEL of the battlefield more than 10″ away from any Enemy model. This Round, the Tal'darim Pylon is not eligible to use its Special Abilities (excluding Structure).

data.note: The card database shows no Resource on this Faction Card (every other Faction Card gives +1). The app follows it, so it can't be Exhausted for PE in Play. Check the printed card.
